about.text: About the project A multilingual Telegram bot for weather forecasts, distance calculations, and approximate walking-time estimates. Project and creator links are below.

settings.text: Settings You can change the current language without sending /start again.

distance.ask_destination: 📍 Destination Send a Telegram Location or enter coordinates in this format: 41.3111, 69.2797
distance.invalid_coordinates: Invalid coordinates. Use latitude, longitude with latitude −90…90 and longitude −180…180.
distance.invalid_input: Please send latitude, longitude coordinates or a Telegram Location.
distance.state_lost: The calculation state was lost. Start the calculation again from the main menu.
distance.weather_unavailable_note: No weather adjustment was applied because current weather could not be retrieved.

advice.normal: Account for actual roads, crossings, and route conditions.
advice.heavy_rain_snow: Move carefully and account for worse surface and visibility conditions.
advice.extreme_heat: Carry water and avoid prolonged direct sun exposure when practical.
advice.extreme_cold: Account for cold conditions and possible slippery surfaces.
